name: Account lost, hacked or family-plan access
model_suggested_name: Hacked accounts and lost playlists
model_description: Customers report their accounts were hacked or locked, and they lost access to playlists and paid subscription value.

name: Other access problems
model_suggested_name: Device connection and token errors
model_description: Customers report trouble connecting Spotify to other devices, missing features like Wrap, and a 'no token provided' error.

name: Login, logout and password problems
model_suggested_name: Login failures and unexpected logouts
model_description: Customers are logged out unexpectedly or cannot log in due to password rejection, phone-number verification errors, or false no-internet messages.

name: Charges, refunds, payments and trials
model_suggested_name: Unexpected charges and confusing charging behavior
model_description: Customers report being confused or dissatisfied by charges and charging-related behavior in the app.

name: Other billing complaints
model_suggested_name: General dissatisfaction with paywalls and restrictions
model_description: Customers feel the app prioritizes making money, forcing payment for features and imposing too many restrictions, and some report subscription screens blocking access despite paying.

name: Features locked behind Premium (skips, song choice, playback)
model_suggested_name: Basic playback features locked behind Premium
model_description: Customers say skipping, replaying, queue playback, shuffle and lyrics were moved behind Premium, forcing them to pay for basic listening.

name: Songs, artists or podcasts unavailable
model_suggested_name: Songs and artists unavailable on Spotify
model_description: Customers report that some underrated or specific songs they want are not available on Spotify, which they say other apps have.

name: Other catalog complaints
model_suggested_name: Missing Bollywood, gospel and favourite songs
model_description: Customers report that their favourite songs, especially Bollywood and gospel music, are missing from the catalog, and some find the app empty or get connection errors.

name: Lyrics missing or broken
model_suggested_name: Lyrics not loading or displaying properly
model_description: Customers report that song lyrics fail to load, do not show for some songs, or display poorly after an update.

name: Recommendations, repeats and smart features
model_suggested_name: Unwanted recommendations added to playlists
model_description: Customers report that Spotify keeps inserting recommended songs into their playlists even after they turn recommendations off, and they want recommendations stopped.

name: Other download problems
model_suggested_name: Downloads fail, stall, or are unavailable
model_description: Customers report that music will not download, gets stuck downloading in the background, or cannot be downloaded at all, and that the app wrongly reports no internet connection.

name: Downloads disappear or must be re-downloaded
model_suggested_name: Downloaded music disappears and must be re-downloaded
model_description: Customers say previously downloaded songs vanish, often after time passes or when storage is moved, forcing them to download content again.

name: Offline mode not working
model_suggested_name: Offline mode fails to work
model_description: Customers report that offline mode does not function, so downloaded music cannot be played without a connection.

name: Boycott / political protest with a complaint or departure
model_suggested_name: Users boycott app over Quran burning in Sweden
model_description: Customers say they are uninstalling Spotify in protest because of Sweden's allowance of Quran burnings.

name: General dissatisfaction, no specific product issue
model_suggested_name: Vague dissatisfaction with app and recent updates
model_description: Customers express general dislike of the app and recent updates without naming a specific product problem.

name: Connection, Bluetooth, car and devices
model_suggested_name: Connection failures with Wi-Fi, internet, and devices
model_description: Customers report the app falsely claims there is no internet connection or fails to connect over Wi-Fi or to linked devices such as Google Home, despite working connectivity elsewhere.

name: App crashes / won't open
model_suggested_name: App crashes, closes, or fails to open after update
model_description: Customers report the app crashing, shutting down during playback, showing a black screen, or refusing to open, especially after a recent update.

name: Other playback problems (bugs, not working)
model_suggested_name: Playback controls, shuffle, and song selection malfunction
model_description: Customers report broken playback behaviour such as loop and skip limits failing, shuffle repeating the same songs, wrong or random tracks playing, and inability to rewind or advance tracks.

name: Lag, slowness, battery and loading
model_suggested_name: App lags or gets stuck on loading screen
model_description: Customers report sluggish performance, lagging podcasts, and the app getting stuck on the loading or logo screen.

name: Music stops, pauses or cuts out
model_suggested_name: Playback randomly stops or pauses mid-track
model_description: Customers report music stopping, pausing, or cutting out mid-song or mid-show, even with a good connection, and failing to resume where it left off.

name: Songs won't play / app not working / bugs
model_suggested_name: Selected songs and playlists fail to play
model_description: Customers report that chosen songs or playlists do not play, play a different song instead, or that the app fails to respond to playback commands and network-dependent features.

name: Customer support contact and response
model_suggested_name: Rude and unhelpful customer support staff
model_description: The customer reports being dissatisfied with Spotify's support team, calling them rude and expressing strong negative sentiment, though the quote gives no specific technical problem.

name: Ad frequency, length and loudness
model_suggested_name: Excessive, loud, unskippable ads interrupting listening
model_description: Users report too many long, loud, unskippable ads between songs and even before music starts, making the free listening experience unbearable.

name: Other usability complaints
model_suggested_name: Broad usability problems: ads, navigation, bugs, and accessibility
model_description: Users report a mix of problems including excessive ads, poor navigation and user-friendliness, bugs, and difficulty for older users, without a single common cause.

name: Playlist, queue and library management
model_suggested_name: Playlist forcing skips and blocking specific song choice
model_description: Users say the app forces playlist playback and limits skips, so they cannot play the specific song they select from their playlists or liked songs.

name: New update / redesign / navigation and layout
model_suggested_name: Disliked update changing layout, features, and home screen
model_description: Users say recent updates removed basic features, changed the layout and home screen, and made it harder to find playlists and music.

name: Forced shuffle / can't choose song order
model_suggested_name: Forced shuffle removes ability to play playlists in order
model_description: Users are upset that the new menu only allows shuffle, removing their ability to play a playlist in its intended order.
